concept: House-Matching Potion Deduction — the solver must infer a hidden 3-House partition (2 ingredients per House) of 6 ingredients from pairwise stability probes, where only 3 of 15 possible pairs are secretly "unstable," then commit to a single verified compatible trio, with failed brews leaking diagnostic feedback about which pair broke it.
hint: Each House holds exactly two ingredients, so once you learn that a pair is unstable, both of those letters are now fully "used up" — every other letter is automatically safe with each of them, no further testing needed there. Since only 3 of the 15 possible pairs are unstable, most probes will come back stable, so prioritize testing letters you haven't touched yet over re-confirming ones you already trust. Track which letters have never appeared in any unstable result — three such letters (one still-unpaired representative per House) are enough to brew safely, so build toward that trio deliberately rather than guessing early.
topic: potion-mixing rules inferred from allowed combinations
